neighborhoods.name: Central Fremont
neighborhoods.homes: apartment complexes and condos near downtown and BART

housing: Fremont's rentals are single-family homes, townhomes and large apartment complexes, many near the BART stations.

localRules.text: Under Fremont's Rent Review Ordinance, landlords must tell tenants in writing about the city's rent review program with any rent increase, and increases over 5 percent can go to the Rent Review Board.
Fremont bars landlords from refusing tenants because of their source of income.

tenantHelp.name: Fremont Rent Review Program

climate: Check the heater and, since many homes have no central AC, ask how the home stays cool; also confirm the water heater is strapped for earthquakes.
fact: The Warm Springs BART station opened in 2017, and many new apartments and townhomes have been built around it.
